spans.s:
Excellent.
2

Exalted, magnanimous.
m. (-टः)
1 A tortoise.
2 The sun.
E.
उद् lofty, भट to desire, and अच् affix; high-minded.

m. (-वः)
Birth, production.
E.
उद् forth, भू to be or become, अच् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Production, generation.
2 Magnanimity.
E.
उद् भाव causing to be, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Productive.
E.
उद्भव, and कर what makes.

n. (-नं)
1 Inattention, neglect, disregard.
2 Saying, speaking.
E.
उद् away or up, भावन observing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Neglected, disregarded.
2 Said, declared.
E.
उद् and भावित made known.

m. (-सः)
Radiance, splendor.
E.
उद् and भास shining.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Lighting up, irradiating.
E.
उद् before भास to shine, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Lighted up, illuminated, splendid.
2 Ornamented, graced, beautified.
E.
उद् before भास to shine, क्त aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
See the next.

mfn. (-ज्जः-ज्जा-ज्जं)
Sprouting, germinating, (as a vegetable.)
E.
उद्भिद a vegetable, and ज produced; also उद्भिज one ज being dropped; also उद्भिद.

mfn. (-द्भिद् or -द्भित्)
Sprouting, germinating.
E.
उद् up, भिद to break or burst, affix क्विप्, or with क affix उद्भिद (-दः-दा-दं.)
n. (-दं)
Culinary salt.
E.
उद् forth, भिद to break, and क affix; breaking from the soil.

n. (-दं)
Sprouting, &c. see the last.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Opened, burst.
2 Budded.
E.
उद् up, and भिन्न broken.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Born, produced.
2 Lofty, literally or figuratively.
3 Visible, perceptible, present.
E.
उद् before भू to be, affix क्त.

n. (-पं)
Visible shape or form.
E.
उद्भूत and रूप form.

Regret.
2

Whirling, flourishing.
E.
उद् much, भ्रम to wander, धञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Agitated, bewildered, distressed.
3 Whirled, flourished, waved (as a sword).
E.
उद् and भ्रान्त revolved.
